title: The Aurora Initiative
description: Humanity's leap beyond the solar frontier, chronicling the crews who seeded the first extrasolar settlements.

events.title: Launch of the Helios Ark
events.description: A multinational crew departs Earth aboard the Helios Ark, bound for Proxima Centauri b.

events.title: Stellar Gate Activation
events.description: Engineers deploy the first quantum gate, linking the Sol system with the Aurora Colony in real time.

events.title: Aurora Council Formed
events.description: Representatives from six colonies ratify the Aurora Accord, establishing a shared charter for expansion.

events.title: Discovery of the Luminous Reef
events.description: Explorers chart a bioluminescent ecosystem beneath the oceans of Kepler-442b, opening new scientific frontiers.

events.title: Echoes Protocol Broadcast
events.description: The Initiative transmits the Echoes Protocol, an interstellar distress network safeguarding future voyages.

title: Chronorift Saga
description: Time agents defend the timeline against paradoxes unleashed by the rogue collective known as the Riftborn.

events.title: First Temporal Breach
events.description: An unauthorized jump in Neo-London triggers cascading anomalies across the 25th century skyline.

events.title: Riftborn Manifesto
events.description: The Riftborn broadcast their manifesto from the year 3120, vowing to rewrite pivotal historical outcomes.

events.title: Operation Silver Thread
events.description: Agents Sera Voss and Malik Ibarra reseal seventeen divergent timelines during a 48-hour field sprint.

events.title: The Parallax Accord
events.description: Warring time-factions agree to the Parallax Accord, placing temporal travel under a unified charter.

events.title: Arrival of the Future Kin
events.description: Allied descendants from the 33rd century arrive to help neutralize the final Riftborn incursion.
